caption:
Car loans are now the second-biggest pile of consumer debt after mortgages. 🚗

The New York Fed says Americans owed $1.713 trillion in auto loans in Q2 2026, up $28 billion in just one quarter.

A monthly payment is easy to say yes to. The total cost is harder to see.

Do you know your loan's APR?
first_comment: Do you know your auto loan APR off the top of your head? 👇
